scripts.dev:all: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; npm run dev:server & npm run dev:ui & wait'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teamtales/ui && npm run build -w @teamtales/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test -w @teamtales/server -- --test-reporter=spec && npm run build && npm run schema:check -w @teamtales/server
